items.title: 14.15.2 Hawa ki aaloodgi par qaboo pane ke iqdamat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.15.2, printed pages 318-319.

items: Gariyon ke ikhraj ke mayar: motor gariyon se aaloodgi ghatane ke liye nafiz, compressed natural gas (CNG) aur liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) jaise saaf fuels ki tarveej aur fuel ke mayar par sakht zabta ke saath.
Sanati ikhraj par qaboo: sanati zaraye se ikhraj ghatana aur sanaton ko saaf paidawar ki techniques aur aaloodgi control technologies apnane ki targheeb.

Awami aagahi muhimmat: awam ko hawa ki aaloodgi ke zaraye aur asrat aur zati hissa ghatane ke tareeqon ki taleem, aur awami transport, car-pooling aur cycling aur paidal chalne jaise ghair-motor transport ki tarveej.
Shehri mansooba-bandi aur sabz infrastructure: shehri ilaqon mein green belts aur parks banana, aur traffic ki bheer ghatane aur paidar transport ki tarveej ke liye mansooba-bandi.

Smog control iqdamat: khaas iqdamat, khaas kar sardi ke mahinon mein jab hawa ka mayar khasa girta hai, jin mein fasal ki baqiyat jalane par pabandi, jo smog mein bara hissa dalti hai, aur particulate matter ghatane ke liye smog towers aur doosri technologies ka istemal shamil hai.
Gharelu aur sanati koora thikane lagane ke liye khuli aag par pabandi, jo dhool, dhuan aur pollutants ki bari miqdar paida karti hai.
Kam-sulfur diesel ka istemal: diesel mein sulfur ki ijazat shuda had ghatana.

blocks.text: In zawabit aur iqdamat se Pakistan hawa ka mayar behtar karne aur awami sehat aur mahol par hawa ki aaloodgi ke bure asrat kam karne ka iradah rakhta hai.

blocks.prompt: Smog par qaboo pane ke khaas iqdamat kya hain (exercise Q.2k)?
blocks.explanation: Sardi par markooz iqdamat: fasal ki baqiyat jalane par pabandi, jo smog mein bhari hissa dalti hai; smog towers aur doosri particulate hatane wali technologies chalana; gariyon ke ikhraj ke mayar aur saaf fuels nafiz karna; sanati aur bhatti ke ikhraj par qaboo; koore ke khule jalne par pabandi; aur zyada smog wale dinon awam ko samna mehdood rakhne ki hidayat.

items: Iqdamat: gariyon ke ikhraj ke mayar aur saaf fuels (CNG, LPG); sanati ikhraj par qaboo; awami aagahi aur awami transport; green belts aur shehri mansooba-bandi; smog control (fasal ki baqiyat par pabandi, smog towers); koore ka khula jalna nahi; kam-sulfur diesel.
